title: Cancel deferred Page Action timers on pagehide

change.behavior: When public authored-content has pending allowlisted page-action timers, pagehide now clears them. This prevents a delayed tab selection from firing after the document begins leaving or is put into the back-forward cache.
change.scope: One page lifecycle cancellation hook; Save and Publish semantics remain separate.

browser.assertions: EDT-039 bounded timer persistence, editor isolation, preview, publication, URL precedence, interaction cancellation, visibility cancellation, pagehide cancellation, popstate cancellation; EDT-040 reduced-motion and publication lifecycle.
